resolution: Implemented the active editor World Bible as an on-disk-source-of-truth wiki: lossless keyed Markdown block parsing, explicit public/secret/author visibility, canonical publishing provenance, searchable and backlinked entity pages, divergent recovery drafts, exact frozen patch review, and confirmation-only writes.
